title: 第二十三章     李朗
content_zh:
历经十数天的赶路，琼霄与蓝湘终于赶上了已先前离开的星辰学院新生队伍。

    在这十几天里，蓝湘对琼霄已经没有了先前的那种冷漠，恰恰相反，如今的蓝湘眼里处处流露出那种极度的柔和。就连蓝湘也不清楚，自己对琼霄到底是什么感觉，只是觉得现在的琼霄对她来说，有些一种说不出的感觉。

    然而，在这十几天中，琼霄也有些享受，因为蓝湘对他不再冷漠，并且，随便他和她开玩笑，那少女也只是笑笑，并没有以前那种要打要杀的行为，她自己默许了他的存在。并且这些天里，琼霄隐隐有些喜欢和蓝湘在一起，他不想到了学院就失去她。

    “学姐，你说我俩现在是什么一种关系？”琼霄探着头说道。

    “嗯？什么关系？能有什么关系，最多就是学姐和学弟的关系吧？”蓝湘淡淡的说道。

    “额，你看我俩，该摸的摸了，该亲的也亲了，难道就没有些别的一些关系在里面？”琼霄厚着脸皮扯道。

    “你休再胡说，再说我可要生气了！”蓝湘小脸上露出了羞怒的表情。

    “好好，我不说了就是，”看着坐在身旁羞怒的蓝湘，琼霄收起了自己的话语。

    就这样静静的坐着，两人都没有说什么话，只是平静的看着山崖下的事物。

    “学姐，你相信缘分么？”平静了半响的琼霄再度开口道。

    “什么是缘分？我不懂……”

    “我相信，相遇是缘分，相知是缘分，学姐，我很珍惜和你在一起的时间，和你在一起的时间是我最快乐的时候！从小开始，我就刻苦的修炼，我只有一个目标，那就是变得更强大！这样我才有资格去实现我的目标！”

    “为什么？你我相遇真的是缘分么？也许只是一次碰巧罢了！”女孩迷茫的说道。

    “不管是不是碰巧，在我看来我认识你这就是缘分，和你在一起的这些天里，我有一种从未有的感觉，我也不清楚这到底是什么，我发现我已经越来越在乎你！曾经的我除了修炼，什么也不管，自从你出现后，我发觉我已经开始变了。”琼霄看着蓝湘，眼里尽是柔和。

    听着琼霄的话语，蓝湘微微一怔，不仅仅是琼霄对他有着感觉，她对琼霄也有着一种奇怪的感觉，她开始觉得要是哪一天她离开了他，她还是不是自己，虽然她比琼霄年长一岁，可从现实意义上来说，几乎没有什么差别，有的只是她比他高一届而已。

    “学姐，你对我有什么感觉？”看着蓝湘，琼霄问道。

    “什么感觉，我也不知道…可能和你对我的感觉是一样的吧……”少女抱着双腿说道。

    一只手突然攀上了蓝湘的后背，蓝湘只觉得背后一凉，想吧那双手打下去，可最终还是没有。“算了吧！就让他抱抱吧，也许到了学院，可能就很少见面了！”少女心中轻叹道。

    “学姐，愿意做我女朋友吗？”琼霄搂着蓝湘认真的说道。

    “女朋友？”蓝湘一惊。

    “嗯嗯，这些天里，我仔细想过了，也许我对你那种说不出的感觉就是喜欢吧！”

    “为什么？”少女微微问道。

    “没有什么原因，要说原因，那就是我喜欢你，我想要是哪一天你不在我身边，我想我会发疯的！”琼霄看着偎依在怀里的蓝湘说。

    “你愿意吗？”

    “我不知道……”

    “不知道那就是愿意了！”琼霄霸道的说道。
content_en:
After more than ten days of traveling, Qiong Xiao and Lan Xiang finally caught up with the freshmen team of Star Academy that had left earlier.

In the past ten days, Lan Xiang has lost the previous indifference towards Qiong Xiao. On the contrary, Lan Xiang's eyes now show that extreme gentleness.Even Lan Xiang doesn't know how she feels about Qiong Xiao. She just feels that Qiong Xiao has some indescribable feelings for her now.

However, during these ten days, Qiong Xiao also enjoyed some enjoyment, because Lan Xiang was no longer indifferent to him, and whenever he joked with her, the girl just smiled and did not act like she did before. She acquiesced to his existence.And these days, Qiong Xiao vaguely likes to be with Lan Xiang. He doesn't want to lose her when he comes to the academy.

"Senior sister, what kind of relationship do you think we have now?" Qiong Xiao asked, leaning her head.

"Huh? What kind of relationship? What kind of relationship can there be? At most, it's the relationship between senior sister and junior brother, right?" Lan Xiang said lightly.

"Well, look at us, we have touched when we should, and kissed when we should kiss. Isn't there some other relationship involved?" Qiong Xiao said shamelessly.

"Stop talking nonsense, or I'll get angry!" A look of shame and anger appeared on Lan Xiang's face.

"Okay, I won't say anything anymore," Qiong Xiao stopped talking as she looked at Lan Xiang, who was sitting next to him in shame and anger.

Just sitting quietly like this, neither of them said anything, they just looked at the things under the cliff calmly.

"Senior sister, do you believe in fate?" Qiong Xiao, who had been calm for a while, said again.

"What is fate? I don't understand..."

"I believe that meeting is fate and knowing each other is fate. Senior sister, I cherish the time with you. The time with you is the happiest time for me! I have been practicing hard since I was a child. I have only one goal, and that is to become stronger! Only in this way can I be qualified to achieve my goal!"

"Why? Is it really fate that you and I met? Maybe it was just a coincidence!" the girl said confused.

"Whether it's a coincidence or not, in my opinion, it's fate that I met you. During these days with you, I have a feeling that I have never felt before. I don't know what it is, but I find that I care about you more and more! I used to care about nothing but cultivation. Since you appeared, I found that I have begun to change." Qiong Xiao looked at Lan Xiang, her eyes full of softness.

Listening to Qiong Xiao's words, Lan Xiang was slightly startled. Not only did Qiong Xiao have feelings for him, but she also had a strange feeling for Qiong Xiao. She began to feel that if one day she left him, she would still not be herself. Although she was one year older than Qiong Xiao, in a practical sense, there was almost no difference. The only thing was that she was one grade higher than him.

"Senior sister, how do you feel about me?" Qiong Xiao asked as she looked at Lan Xiang.

"I don't know what it feels like...maybe it's the same as how you feel about me..." the girl said, hugging her legs.

A hand suddenly climbed up Lan Xiang's back. Lan Xiang felt a chill on his back. He thought about hitting it with his hands, but in the end he didn't."Forget it! Just let him hug you. Maybe when we get to the academy, we may rarely see each other!" The girl sighed softly in her heart.

"Senior sister, are you willing to be my girlfriend?" Qiong Xiao hugged Lan Xiang and said seriously.

"Girlfriend?" Lan Xiang was surprised.

"Hmm, I've thought about it carefully these days. Maybe my indescribable feeling for you is just that I like you!"

"Why?" the girl asked slightly.

"There is no reason. If I want to talk about the reason, it is that I like you. If I want you to be without me one day, I think I will go crazy!" Qiong Xiao said looking at Lan Xiang who was nestled in her arms.

"Would you do that?"

"I don't know..."

"I don't know, that means I am willing!" Qiong Xiao said domineeringly.
